title: Speed of Sound Determination
theory: $V = f\lambda$ with $\lambda$ extracted from resonance geometry (Topic 28) is *the* standard determination. $V$ grows with temperature ($V \approx 331.5 + 0.6\,t[°C]$ m/s — MEXT tests the direction, not the coefficient). **Worked variants:** 2015-Q5 parts (2) and (4) above.
